100 MEMORY &6FFF:AD=&7000
105 FOR I=1 TO 536
110 READ A$
112 REM                                     REM  *******   VOCABULAIRE  *******     REM
115 FOR K=0 TO 4:POKE AD+K,VAL(MID$(A$,2*K+1,2)):NEXT K
120 AD=AD+5:P=11
122 REM                                     REM  *******    CONDITION   *******     REM
125 K$=MID$(A$,P,1):IF K$="." THEN 200
130 IF K$="L" OR K$="M" THEN 150
135 POKE AD,ASC(K$):POKE AD+1,VAL(MID$(A$,P+1,3)):P=P+4:AD=AD+2:GOTO 125
150 POKE AD,ASC(K$):POKE AD+1,VAL(MID$(A$,P+1,3)):POKE AD+2,VAL(MID$(A$,P+4,3)):P=P+7:AD=AD+3:GOTO 125
200 REM                                     REM  *******     ACTION     *******     REM
205 P=P+1
210 K$=MID$(A$,P,1):IF K$="." THEN 300
215 IF K$="G" OR K$="R" OR K$="Y" THEN 270
216 IF K$="A" OR K$="Z" OR K$="J" OR K$="K" OR K$="L" OR K$="M" OR K$="N" OR K$="T" OR K$="U" THEN 250
220 POKE AD,ASC(K$)+32:POKE AD+1,VAL(MID$(A$,P+1,3)):P=P+4:AD=AD+2:GOTO 210
250 POKE AD,ASC(K$)+32:AD=AD+1:GOTO 205
270 POKE AD,ASC(K$)+32:POKE AD+1,VAL(MID$(A$,P+1,3)):POKE AD+2,VAL(MID$(A$,P+4,3)):P=P+7:AD=AD+3:GOTO 210
300 POKE AD,255:AD=AD+1:NEXT I:POKE AD,254
499 END
500 PRINT"ERREUR EN LIGNE: ";10000+10*I:PRINTA$:PRINTK$
510 END
1000 REM *********************
1010 REM **     LISTING     **
1020 REM *********************
1030 REM
1040 FOR I=1 TO 532:READ A$
1050 I$=MID$(STR$(I),2):I$=STRING$(3-LEN(I$),"0")+I$+":  "
1060 PRINT#8,I$;:FOR K=1 TO 9 STEP 2:PRINT#8,MID$(A$,K,2)+" ";:NEXT K
1070 PRINT#8,MID$(A$,11):NEXT I
1080 END

30000 INPUT A$,B$,A,B
30010 FOR I=1 TO 536
30020 READ K$
30030 IF MID$(K$,A*2-1,2)<>A$ THEN 30060
30040 IF MID$(K$,B*2-1,2)<>B$ THEN 30060
30050 PRINTI,K$
30060 NEXT
30070 RUN 30000
40000 INPUT A$
40010 FOR I=1 TO 536
40020 READ K$:IF INSTR(K$,A$)=0 THEN 40040
40030 PRINTI,K$
40040 NEXT
40050 RUN 40000
